channel.title: RoboCop 2
channel.desc: Cyborg Detroit policeman Alex Murphy is the sole officer on duty after the police force goes on strike against evil conglomerate Omni Consumer Products and its push to foreclose on the city of Detroit. Aside from dealing with the normal level of crime, Murphy must take on crime boss Cain, the spread of a dangerous new drug called Nuke and the attempt by psychologist Dr. Juliette Faxx to create another RoboCop using a hardened criminal.
